sentences.text: 1. Heard Ms. B. Sarma, learned counsel for the appellant.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellant/claimant impugning the judgment and order dated 05.08.2025 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Cachar, Silchar, in MAC Case No. 148/2021 whereby the appellant was awarded an amount of Rs.6,26,229/- along with interest thereon.
3.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Cachar, Silchar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant is mainly aggrieved with the quantum of compensation awarded to her.
4. I have gone through the grounds taken in the memo of appeal and have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.
5. This appeal is admitted.

6. Let the records of MAC Case No. 148/2021 be called for from the concerned tribunal.
7.
The Registry shall take steps for requisitioning the records.
8. Issue notice to the respondents.
9. The appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable 22nd of May, 2026.
